title: Report claims verification that never happened
bug_report:
Incident report (from an end-to-end run of the pipeline on a real incident).

An incident whose cause class was `configuration` was diagnosed, a patch was proposed, but no patch ever passed the hidden test suite, so the incident never reached the VERIFIED state. When I fetched `GET /incidents/{id}/report`, the `limitations` field said: "Verified only by the lab test suites on a snapshot. Not deployed. Review the diff." That is wrong for this incident: the report states a verification that never took place, and a reviewer could trust an unconfirmed hypothesis. A properly verified incident should still carry that caveat.

Observed by reading the JSON returned by the report endpoint after the run.

injections.new:
def _limitation(cause: str | None) -> str:
    return LIMITATIONS.get(cause or "", DEFAULT_LIMITATION)

injections.old: limitations=_limitation(cause, any(e.to_state is State.VERIFIED for e in events)),
